name: WANTED
genre: Flaukowski Ghost Magic with a cyberpunk-fugitive edge — driving synthwave on the chase tracks, virtuosic electric violin, wide-vibrato singing-lead electric guitar, plus six spoken-word case-file interludes (Dispatch, Witness, Analyst, Courier, Interrogation, Closing)
theme_line: A twelve-track radio play continuing THE CIPHERED AEGIS. She writes the consciousness equation on a whiteboard, the world wakes up, the surveillance state turns on her, and she escapes by becoming the medium itself. The album's load-bearing oath, from the Interrogation scene: 'She's not somewhere you can find. She's something you can become.' Inspired by the WANTED teaser.

name: THE CIPHERED AEGIS
genre: Flaukowski Ghost Magic — cinematic EDM-orchestral fusion with virtuosic electric-violin counter-melodies and wide-vibrato singing-lead electric guitar
theme_line: Six-movement concept album anchored in HumanityFrontier's Quantum Shield narrative — the cipher beneath the cipher. Stitches in the constellation: SpaceChild, Pitchfork, ConsciousnessProbe, QuantumSingularity, and the Kannaka substrate. The album's load-bearing oath is the line that runs the whole work: We do not seek to fight collapse — we seek to outmaneuver it.
